plan: [ This is a one-shot, independent private-values, second-price auction. The dominant strategy is to bid my true value: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks winning at a price above my value; underbidding risks losing when winning would be profitable. No history to learn from this round. Bids allow 0.1 increments, so I can bid exactly 28. I will bid my value to secure all cases where the second-highest bid is below 28 and avoid unprofitable wins. ]

Second-price sealed-bid auction with iid private values (0–49). With three bidders, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Overbidding risks winning at a price above my value; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. No history to exploit, so no behavioral adjustment. With $0.1 increments, bid exactly 36.0. This strategy maximizes expected profit this round and in the long run.
